profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Realtor.com
profile.summary:
Senior frontend engineer with 15+ years of experience building complex web applications, internal platforms, and customer-facing products across enterprise and startup environments.

Specializes in React, TypeScript, and frontend architecture, with a focus on modernizing legacy systems, improving performance, and enabling scalable development across teams.

Experience includes driving architecture standards, building micro-frontend systems, and developing internal tools that improve engineering velocity and product delivery. Recently focused on integrating AI-powered workflows into production applications and engineering practices.

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description:
• Defined and drove adoption of frontend architecture standards across multiple teams, improving consistency and reducing long-term maintenance overhead
• Led modernization of legacy frontend systems, enabling continued feature delivery without full rewrites
• Built LLM-powered workflows for internal applications, automating multi-step operational tasks
• Introduced feature flagging and entitlement systems for controlled rollout of in-progress features
• Established mock data and request handler patterns, enabling parallel frontend/backend development
• Drove TypeScript-first development and expanded automated testing, improving reliability and release confidence
• Led adoption of AI-assisted development workflows across engineering teams
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Node.js · Next.js · Claude

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
• Defined frontend architecture and built React-based micro-frontends enabling independent development across teams
• Designed and built admin interfaces for a large-scale e-discovery platform
• Implemented cross-application notifications supporting alerts, process tracking, and deep linking
• Optimized frontend performance and introduced UX instrumentation
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Front-end · Git · Agile Methodologies · Linux · HTML · TypeScript · Web Applications · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js
